changed: A list opened through your account closes when you sign out, and reopens with your unsent edits when you sign back in.
fixed: Signing in to another account no longer sends the last account's unsent list edits, or adds its gear to My Gear, as the new one.
Edits typed after you were signed out in another tab are kept on this device until you sign back in.
Switching accounts with a list open now shows which of its gear the account you switched to already has in My Gear.
